description: This Java source file defines a handler class for deleting general ledger (GL) accounts. It implements the command pattern to process delete commands, utilizing the GLAccountWritePlatformService to perform the deletion.

classes.name: DeleteGLAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service component that handles delete commands for GL accounts by invoking the appropriate service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command and delegates the deletion to the GLAccountWritePlatformService.
